question: Should Crabline continue supporting Node 22, or intentionally raise its runtime and declaration baseline to Node 26?
rationale: The dependency-only patch cannot safely choose the project’s supported runtime policy, and accepting Node 26 declarations while advertising Node 22 creates a compatibility gap.

options.title: Retain Node 22 declarations
options.body: Reject or revise this bump so compile-time APIs remain aligned with the currently advertised Node 22 runtime.

options.title: Coordinate a Node 26 baseline
options.body: Raise runtime metadata, CI coverage, setup documentation, and upgrade guidance together before adopting Node 26 declarations.

recommendation.title: Retain Node 22 declarations
recommendation.body: Reject or revise this bump so compile-time APIs remain aligned with the currently advertised Node 22 runtime.
